shared_elements: horizontal register/border line beneath the cartouches
downward radiating straight rays terminating in small hands
raised/sunk relief human or figural forms with striated garment lines
justification: Both surfaces show the highly distinctive motif of straight rays descending from above and terminating in small open hands, set beneath a row of oval name-enclosures with a horizontal dividing band, accompanied by columns/rows of small script signs and relief figures below — a very specific and arbitrary combination unlikely to arise independently. The main difference is that A preserves the full composition (the central disc, the offering table piled with goods, the elongated pair of adorants and attendant small figures) while B is a fragment in which the disc and the figures' relationships are largely lost, showing only ray-hands, enclosures and striated figural surfaces.
